y_lines.note: Intermediate line carrying a horizontal B5 beam between grids ก and ข, found by the beam-endpoint rule (spec §4): that B5 lands on no named grid, so the grid master was incomplete without it. It sits roughly mid-way (visually ~2.25 m) but NO dimension is printed for it anywhere on S-02, so pos_m is left null rather than assumed to be exactly half of 4.50.

Same as the ข' line but in the upper half: an intermediate line carrying a horizontal B5 beam between grids ข and ค. Named off ค per the reading-direction rule (y-axis scans top to bottom). pos_m undimensioned, left null.
